name: VitaSeq
description: VitaSeq is developing a blood-based diagnostic test that uses a patented microRNA signature to detect Alzheimer's-associated cognitive decline years before symptom onset. The test produces a cognition score reflecting brain health, targeting the early Alzheimer's detection market where current gold-standard diagnostics (CSF and PET) are invasive, costly, and used too late.
team: Pitch presented by Florian Erber to Ananda Impact Ventures; founding team details not specified in the deck, though the underlying microRNA signature science was published in EMBO Molecular Medicine (Islam et al. 2021).
latest_news: VitaSeq, a Hamburg-based medtech startup developing microRNA-based blood tests for early Alzheimer's detection, pitched at the STARTERiN conference in December 2025 and is targeting 2028 for medical device approval.

name: Cardiovolt.ai
description: Cardiovolt.ai provides Software as a Medical Device (SaMD) that uses AI to detect hidden heart disease in standard ECGs, identifying 14 cardiac and 3 non-cardiac conditions before symptoms appear. The company sells B2B to healthcare providers and pharma/life sciences companies, targeting the 1B+ ECGs performed globally each year to enable proactive cardiac care and enrich clinical trials.
team: The pitch deck does not provide specific details on the founding team or their backgrounds.

name: HotHouse Therapeutics
description: HotHouseTx is a spin-out from the John Innes Centre's Osbourn Lab that combines AI-driven drug design (BotanAI) with a plant-based bioproduction platform (BotanBio) to design, make, and test complex natural product-like compounds on drug-discovery timelines. Its initial focus is on next-generation vaccine adjuvants, with a broader vision of sustainable, plant-made therapeutics.
team: Led by CEO Dr David Sheppard (ex-EntactBio founder, 26 years in biotech) and CSO Professor Anne Osbourn OBE FRS (world leader in plant metabolic engineering), with Dr Phil Spence heading informatics and Ivan Griffin (ex-BenevolentAI) as CBO/Co-Founder. Advised by Adrian Hill of the Jenner Institute.
latest_news: HotHouse Therapeutics emerged from stealth with £2.9 million (~$3.8M) in pre-seed funding from SynBioVen, Start Codon, UKI2S, Twin Path Ventures, Wren Capital, angel investors, and an Innovate UK grant to develop its AI-powered plant bioengineering platform for sustainable drug discovery.

name: Sapio Health
description: Sapio Health is building Horizon-1, a continuous physics engine for human health that fuses multi-modal clinical and wearable data to model disease trajectories over time. It serves both clinicians (via detection, coding, and messaging interfaces sold to providers) and patients (via a freemium app), targeting the chronic disease and primary care market in the UK and US.
team: The pitch deck does not provide explicit details about the founding team or their backgrounds.

source_file: VUS Genetics - Seed Investment Deck - Non conf - May 2026.pdf
name: VUS Genetics
description: VUS Genetics is building a proprietary functional genomics and data intelligence platform that links drug target discovery, patient stratification, and clinical outcomes to improve oncology drug development success rates. Its first product, ATMpredict, identifies ATM-mutant cancer patients who could benefit from ATR inhibitor therapies, enabling label expansion for biotech and pharma partners.
team: The team is supported by 4 international clinical research collaborators and has signed an exclusive license on a novel gene editing approach, with 9 MSAs signed with biotech and pharma partners indicating commercial traction. Specific founder backgrounds are not detailed in the deck.
latest_news: VUS Genetics participated at BIO-Europe Spring 2026 (March 23-25, 2026) in Lisbon as a presenting company, and representatives attended the CRISPR Medicine 2026 conference and Perturb2026 High-content CRISPR screening conference in Vienna.

name: Collo
description: Collo provides liquid process intelligence for Food & Beverage manufacturing, using a novel radio frequency-based inline liquid analyzer combined with AI/ML algorithms and a SaaS platform. The technology identifies and automates optimal operating conditions, reducing product loss, water usage, and quality-related costs in liquid processing.
team: The team is not described in the provided pitch deck excerpt.

name: FlowBio
description: FlowBio appears to be a health/biotech startup, but the provided pitch deck text contains no substantive content beyond a title and page reference. A meaningful description cannot be extracted from the available material.
team: No information about the founding team or their backgrounds is provided in the supplied text.
latest_news: FLOWBIO appointed Stephen Moon (former CEO of Science in Sport Group) as non-executive chair and launched a hydration planning tool for S1 sensor users.

name: Flux Clinic
description: The company is developing an autonomous, low-field MRI device focused on early detection of prostate cancer, designed to be deployed in freestanding imaging centers under a per-scan commercial model. It targets the existing ~$400M US reimbursed prostate MRI pathway, with plans to expand into broader screening as guidelines evolve.
team: The founding team is not described in the provided pitch deck text, so relevant backgrounds cannot be summarized.

name: Health Concierge
description: Health Concierge offers an AI-powered hospital discharge platform that automates patient transition tasks—like finding specialists, verifying availability, and generating paperwork—to reduce discharge delays. Targeting US hospitals facing a $100B care transition inefficiency problem, the platform embeds into existing clinical workflows to free beds, cut costs, and improve patient outcomes.
team: The team is supported by a roster of advisors including Cynthia Henderson PhD, Erin Donnelly, Gary Paquin, Justin Force, Nigel Daniels, Duane Cooney, Trista Taylor, Denis Victor, and Khalid Turk, and has assembled a nationwide consulting team of 6 industry experts covering most of the US.

name: POSTMAN (by the team behind POSTMAN-1)
description: The company builds foundation models that generate missing patient biological data from existing measurements, predicting one modality (e.g., spatial proteomics markers like CD20, PD-L1, LAG3) from another (e.g., H&E slides). Their first model, POSTMAN-1, is a 1B-parameter in silico spatial proteomics model aimed at the pharma R&D and multimodal patient data market, competing in a space led by players like Tempus.
team: Founded by CEO Yue Dai, formerly core technical staff on the $400M Pathos–AstraZeneca deal and IEEE-published, and CTO Oded Falik, who built Enable Medicine's spatial biology platform scaled to 12B+ single-cell annotations. Both have deep technical backgrounds in AI and multimodal biological data.

name: Vitroscope
description: Vitroscope builds a patented perfusion-based phenotyping platform that keeps human organoids, tissues, and cell models viable and physiologically relevant in the lab for longer than existing methods. It targets the pharma drug R&D market, replacing inaccurate well plates and animal models with humanized in vitro systems for screening, discovery, and optimization.
team: Founded by three PhDs covering complementary domains: CEO Carlo Kriesi (biomedical engineering, ETH Zurich/CERN), CTO Heikki Sjöman (IoT/mechatronics, Aalto/Stanford), and CBDO Sandra Jernström (tissue/oncology postdoc, ex-CSO of Okomera). Backed by advisors from Emerald Cloud Labs, Charles River Laboratories, KPMG, and the University of Oxford.
latest_news: Vitroscope announced a €3M seed round led by an EU deep tech VC, added Dr. Julia Schueler (Charles River Laboratories) to their advisory team, and held an entrepreneurial panel at the University of Pittsburgh with investor Reinforced Ventures.

name: Enacuity
description: Enacuity develops AI-powered software that transforms standard surgical camera feeds into functional imaging, displaying tissue oxygenation without requiring new hardware. The company targets the surgical imaging market, starting with laparoscopic colorectal surgery where visualizing tissue perfusion can reduce anastomotic leak complications.
team: Founded by Imperial and TUM PhD graduates with expertise in surgical imaging and computer vision, including co-founders from Odin Vision, Digital Surgery, and TympaHealth. The team is supported by consultants with 15+ years of MedTech industry experience and clinical advisors who are practicing colorectal surgeons.
latest_news: EnAcuity was awarded a prestigious Innovate UK Smart Grant worth £300,840 to support the development of their software-only surgical hyperspectral imaging solution.

name: OtoImmune
description: OtoImmune is building a precision immunology platform that uses multi-omic data and AI to detect chronic inflammatory and autoimmune conditions earlier, provide personalized patient insights, and improve treatment decisions. The company offers a mobile app with clinical-grade testing, AI-driven interpretation, and connections to specialist care, targeting a £44B market across patients, clinicians, and pharma discovery partnerships.
team: Co-founded by Dr. Jason Mellad (CEO) and Dan Rooke (COO), both with backgrounds from Start Codon and experience in health technology, genomics, and biomodal platforms. The team includes Dr. Yacine Dahman as Head of AI and Engineering with prior experience at Congenica.
latest_news: OtoImmune representatives attended the Health + AI Insiders Tech Show, introducing both OtoImmune and their product mOI Health, which aims to support patients tackling autoimmunity and chronic inflammatory conditions.

name: Srotas Health
description: Srotas Health is an agentic AI platform that automates end-to-end clinical trial patient recruitment, including identification, screening, and engagement. The company addresses the problem that 80% of clinical trials fail to complete on time due to poor enrollment, targeting a $7.8B TAM across oncology, cardiology, and CNS trials in the US, UK, and EU.
team: Co-founded by Suman Bhaskaran (CEO) with 14+ years in healthcare AI, pharma, and clinical research, and Vikram Parimi (CTO) with 14+ years in AI & healthcare who previously built clinical AI systems for major pharma companies including Pfizer and AstraZeneca.
latest_news: Srotas Health has raised $335K in funding from investors including MaRS Discovery District, SFC Capital, DigitalHealth.London Accelerator, and lablab NEXT. As of February 2026, the company has grown to 14 employees.

name: Pabel
description: Pabel is building a clinical AI foundation model that analyzes EEG (brain signal) data to improve neurological diagnostics and accelerate biomarker research. The company targets neurologists, neuroscience researchers, and clinical research organizations (CROs) with automated EEG interpretation that reduces misdiagnosis rates and addresses the shortage of certified EEG specialists.
team: Two technical co-founders: Stan Haaijer, an AI engineer from University of Amsterdam who previously developed medical LLMs, and Georg Panteleev, who has co-founded multiple B2B SaaS startups with 100k+ users and secured €2.5M in prior funding. Both have invested €20k of personal capital.

name: AURApeutics
description: AURApeutics is developing ultrasound-responsive nanoparticles to transform existing antibiotics for treating chronic infections caused by biofilms. Their platform can reduce antibiotic concentrations by 44-fold while achieving 100% bacterial eradication, addressing the growing antimicrobial resistance crisis in chronic wounds, UTIs, and implant infections.
team: Led by Dr. Victor Choi (CEO) with 6 years in biotechnology consulting and IET Outstanding Researcher award, supported by Eleanor Stride FREng OBE (Statutory Professor of Biomaterials, founder of 3 spin-outs) and Mr. Fadi Issa (Professor of Immunology, Consultant Burns surgeon).

source_file: motus med Pre-Seed Investor Deck June 2026.pdf
name: motus med
description: motus med is a Charité spin-out developing clinical video AI for epilepsy care. The platform analyzes seizure videos to detect, classify, and structure seizure events, turning hours of video review into minutes and supporting faster clinical decisions. They target epilepsy centers facing review bottlenecks and aim to reduce costs while improving diagnosis and treatment timing.
team: Charité spin-out, indicating founding team with academic medical background from one of Europe's largest university hospitals. Specific founder details not provided in the deck.
latest_news: Motus med is a startup-in-formation supported by the BIH Digital Health Accelerator program, developing an AI-powered seizure detection diagnostic tool for infants and toddlers using smartphone video analysis. They were actively seeking a CEO/co-founder as of mid-2024.

name: Sentinal4D
description: Sentinal4D uses AI to analyze 3D/4D cell shape and morphology from living cell videos to predict drug efficacy and resistance. The company aims to reduce pharmaceutical R&D costs by identifying which drug candidates will succeed in clinical trials, targeting the $60-70B assay market where current methods fail to inform go/no-go decisions.
team: Founded by researchers from ICR (Institute of Cancer Research) and Imperial College, with world-leading expertise in cancer imaging. The team has high-profile publications in Science, Cell, and Nature.
latest_news: Sentinal4D moved to Stevenage Bioscience Catalyst campus after transitioning from The Institute of Cancer Research (ICR).

name: EZYNOS
description: EZYNOS is building an infrastructure layer for the €50B pet hardgoods industry by designing proprietary PFAS-free, bio-sourced polymer formulations and licensing the material standard plus production playbook to brands. They operate a fabless model with qualified Tier-1 automotive/aerospace subcontractors, targeting 80% CO2 and waste reduction versus conventional disposable pet products.
team: Co-founded by Laura Serre (B2C/community background, built Just For Pets to €541K revenue with zero paid acquisition) and David Gonzalez (15 years elastomer science at Michelin, 20+ WO patents filed, designed the material and deployment stack).

name: Zenco
description: Zenco produces biofertilizers and renewable natural gas from seaweed-based feedstock, targeting the fertilizer, renewable energy, and biofuels markets. The company cultivates seaweed that is pelletized and processed via anaerobic digestion to create biomethane and organic fertilizers, with plans to expand into synthetic fuels.

name: Kairo Bio
description: Kairo Bio is building a precision immunology AI platform that combines functional immune assays with human reference data to predict immune responses and improve clinical trial success rates. The company targets biotech and pharma companies developing immune therapies, addressing the $412B annual cost of clinical trial failures in immunology.
team: Co-founded by Antonio Bordería Giner, PhD (CEO) with 15+ years in biology and AI, and Darragh Duffy, PhD (CSO) with 20+ years in immunology research and 200+ papers, who served as scientific coordinator of the Milieu Intérieur project.
latest_news: Kairo Health raised a $500K seed round from Y Combinator as part of the Summer 2024 batch, building AI agents to automate healthcare workforce tasks.

name: Rapidemic
description: Rapidemic develops rapid, instrument-free molecular diagnostic tests for infectious diseases, starting with sexually transmitted infections like chlamydia and gonorrhea. Their platform delivers lab-grade accuracy in 15 minutes without complex equipment, targeting a $3.2B market opportunity in decentralized point-of-care and at-home testing.
team: International team of 15 expert scientists, engineers, QA/RA and commercial specialists with over 75 years combined experience in molecular diagnostics. Founded in 2021 after winning the grand prize at MIT's iGEM synthetic biology competition, led by CEO Violette Defourt.
latest_news: Rapidemic secured a $2.7 million grant from the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation to develop RapiDetect CT/NG, a power-free molecular diagnostic test for STIs that delivers results in under 15 minutes.

name: Swift Robotics
description: Swift Robotics develops companion robots called Nova for elderly care facilities. The robots provide 24/7 fall detection, medication reminders, voice-interactive companionship, and health monitoring through voice biomarkers. They are targeting the UK's £16B+ long-term adult care market amid a growing staffing crisis and aging population.
team: Four-person founding team led by CEO Michal Kostyal, COO Baran Sahan, CTO Yegor Gemba, and Business Lead Yogi Kurniawan, with expertise at the intersection of AI, robotics, and healthcare.
latest_news: Swift Robotics (founded 2020, London) won a Grantify IUK (Innovate UK) grant and has 16 employees as of April 2026. The company develops autonomous indoor delivery robots for hospitals and AI-powered elderly companion robots but has not raised external funding.
